title: Entities & Prefabs
description: Every item in a scene is an entity configured through modular components. A prefab saves an entity and its children as a reusable template across scenes.

blocks.content: An **entity** is a building block in your scene, such as a player, enemy, tilemap, or user interface (UI) button. Every entity has an **Object** identity section and a [Transform & UI Transform](components/transform) component, and you attach extra components in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) to give it visuals, physics, audio, or logic.
A **prefab** is a reusable entity template stored in the **Prefabs** panel of the bottom dock. When you update a master prefab, all synced instances in your scenes update automatically.

items.title: Object Identity
items.desc: Every entity has a unique **ID**, **Z-Index**, and active or visible states.

items.title: Multi-Tag System
items.desc: Assign multiple tags to an entity so scripts can filter or group targets.

items.title: Master Prefabs
items.desc: Convert any configured entity tree into a reusable **World** or **UI** template.

items.title: Live Overrides
items.desc: Customize individual prefab instances and push or revert edits at any time.

blocks.content: You can create an entity from the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or directly in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport), then convert it into a prefab for reuse.

items: In the **Scene Hierarchy**, right-click a **World** or **User Interface** layer row.
Hover over **Add Entity** (or **Add UI Element**) and choose a template such as **Sprite**, **Shape**, **Text**, or **Empty Entity**.
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), configure the entity's **Object** settings, transform, and components.
Right-click the entity in the **Scene Hierarchy** and click **Use as Prefab**.
Enter a prefab name and click **Create**. The entity icon turns into a blue box and the template appears in the **Prefabs** dock.

blocks.message: To spawn a new copy of a prefab, open the **Prefabs** tab in the bottom dock, right-click the prefab, and choose **Instantiate to...**.

blocks.content: Every entity displays the **Object** section at the top of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).

blocks.content: When an entity is linked to a prefab, each section header in the inspector displays a **Sync** (green) or **Override** (amber) badge. Open the 3-dots menu on the **Object** header to manage the prefab link.

rows: Saves all local property overrides on this instance back to the master prefab, updating all synced instances.
Resets all components, tags, and states back to the master prefab values while keeping the instance's current X and Y position.
Available in an individual component's 3-dots menu. Reverts only that component to the master prefab.
Breaks the link to the master prefab and turns the instance into a regular standalone entity.

blocks.content: Use tags and prefabs together when you build repeatable gameplay items such as coins, enemies, or projectiles.

items: Create a **Sprite** entity and name its **ID** **Enemy_Slime**.
In the **Object** section, open the **Tag** dropdown, click **Create New Tag...**, and add the tag **Enemy**.
Right-click **Enemy_Slime** in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) and click **Use as Prefab**.
Spawn multiple instances across your level from the **Prefabs** dock. Move each instance freely without breaking its **Sync** status.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Entity & Transform](node_library/game_entity) to spawn prefabs, manage entity lifecycles, and query tags at runtime.
